newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down amid low volume.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down amid low volume.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Friday amid low volumes on newspaper reports of Pakistan not yet getting its stalled tranche of an IMF standby loan, dealers said. Friday's trading was the first after some 20 years of observing the day as Islamic weekend.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 13.28 points, or 0.94 percent, to end at 1,397.49. Losers led gainers 122 to 68. "There has been no official announcement from the IMF about the standby loan, but people have started speculating on these news reports," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. Hub Power Co fell 0.50 to 30.95 rupees and PTCL 0.55 to 33.50.
